turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does Owen have a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Owen found out about that zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me first. So tell me who decided, and when.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it can't be the sole basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen of these tools were tested and found neither accurate nor reliable, and your own procedure, section 4.3, says software results don't establish a concern by themselves. Did you speak to Owen before the zero went in?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Section 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. Withdraw the zero, Hale.
I hope you understand my position.
"Hope" isn't a document, Hale. My position is the same: the zero comes off, and I get an apology. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
